annotations.text:
All four show the same moment: one line typed, a miss on the next,
the rest still to come.

The number that matters is the untyped text, because that is what you
have to read in order to type it.

  Dark (current)         1.96:1   below AA
  Dark high contrast     5.99:1   clears AA
  Light                  4.74:1   clears AA
  Light high contrast    7.89:1   clears AAA

Every colour in the three new themes was computed against its own
background, not eyeballed.

One thing the welcome screen has to answer: which theme paints it,
before anyone has chosen.

It is drawn here in dark high contrast, so the choice itself is
legible. Starting in the current dark theme would mean a first-time
visitor reads the picker at 1.96:1.

Better still: seed the initial pick from the system — prefers-color-scheme
for dark or light, prefers-contrast: more for the high contrast pair —
so the highlighted card is already the right one when the page opens.
